manual.warlockery.distilling.title: Warlockery: Distilling
manual.warlockery.distilling.preamble: This book teaches how the Distillery pulls secret drops from magical things. Give it the shown ingredients, clay jars, and altar power. Each recipe page shows what goes in and what comes out.
manual.warlockery.distilling.inputs:
Distillation separates a substance from the secret it would rather keep. The Distillery accepts only the items and fluids named by its recipe.

Known workings refine Condensed Fear, Diamond Vapor, Ender Dew, Infernal Blood, Whiff of Magic, Refined Evil, and Oil of Vitriol. Insert the full measured input and leave valid empty output spaces; an iron sword or unrelated trinket has no business in the still and is refused.
manual.warlockery.distilling.outputs:
Condensed Fear is dread made weighable. Diamond Vapor carries a gem's unyielding clarity.

Ender Dew beads where distance folds. Infernal Blood keeps a demon's heat.

Whiff of Magic is raw craft made scent. Refined Evil is malice stripped of noise.

Oil of Vitriol is the biting spirit of mineral acid. Some workings return more than one product, so every required output slot must be clear before the still begins.

Its floating words identify the missing input, fluid, vessel, power, blocked result, and progress.
manual.warlockery.distilling.automation:
Hoppers and fitted pipes may feed accepted ingredients and draw finished products. Pumps may fill or drain recipes that call for fluids.

Each face honors the vessel within, and no mechanism can force an invalid trinket into storage. A redstone comparator may observe the work.

If an unattended still stops, read its single floating display before dismantling it; breaking one part must never multiply displays or leave phantom work behind.
manual.warlockery.herbology.title: Warlockery: Herbology
manual.warlockery.herbology.preamble: This is a guide to the warlock's garden. Every plant has a page that says where it grows, how to harvest it, and what its magic is good for. The last lessons teach safe plant mutations.
manual.warlockery.herbology.crops:
A warlock's garden is a calendar written in roots. Water Artichoke favors wet ground and yields artichoke.

Belladonna gives the poisonous herb behind many brews. Mandrake roots wake angrily when harvested.

Dreamroot is born from a prepared Mandrake mutation. Plant its bulbs on farmland; a dropped bulb can wake into an unbound living Dreamroot. Snowbell offers Icy Needles.

Wolfsbane troubles lycanthropes and serves their rites. Wormwood and its seeds favor spirit and brewing work.

Garlic grows into both food and a vampire ward. Beyond the beds, Ember Moss burns at a touch, Glint Weed shines, Spanish Moss hangs, Somnian Cotton gathers dreams, Leaping Lilies stir water, Blood Roses drink violence, and Bramble, Void Bramble, Grasspers, Pitgrass, and Critter Snares each have narrower uses.
manual.warlockery.herbology.mutations:
Mutandis persuades living blocks into neighboring forms; Mutandis Extremis reaches rarer outcomes. A Mutating Sprig is the ritual hand for prepared mutations.

Grasspers hold catalysts where a full circle would be too coarse. Toad and Dreamroot transformations require an exact arrangement around a cobweb over water, living participants, and charged ingredients.

The floating display names each missing snare, crop, catalyst, creature, charge, or position and shows a green check only when the living diagram is complete.
manual.warlockery.herbology.toad_mutatio:
Use the Mutating Sprig on a cobweb over water. Place four diagonal Grasspers one to three blocks from the center, holding three Mutandis Extremis and one Attuned Stone with stored power. Keep at least four slime-filled Critter Snares and a cat or ocelot within four blocks horizontally.

A successful mutation consumes the cobweb, the four offerings and the cat or ocelot, empties the snares, and costs one sprig durability. One Toad forms per filled snare. The offered Attuned Stone is consumed, so use a spare. The Mutating Sprig page gives the other prepared mutations.
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_mu: Dreamroot mutation: place four mature Mandrakes on the cardinal rays and four diagonal Grasspers holding two Mutandis Extremis, Focused Will, and a charged Attuned Stone around a cobweb over water. Bring a Creeper and a living Mandrake, then use the Sprig to change all four crops.
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_bu:
Use a Dreamroot Bulb on farmland to plant a crop. A bulb dropped loose can instead wake into a living Dreamroot after at least three seconds. Each waking consumes one bulb; stacks wake in batches of at most four, with further waking delayed when the world is busy.

Dropping a bulb does not tame or bind the creature. Plant directly when you want to continue growing the crop. The named Dreamroot Bulb page in Cultivated Herbs gives the full use instructions.
manual.warlockery.herbology.safe_harvest:
Harvest mature crops to collect their produce and seeds. Keep a weapon ready when uprooting Mandrakes; harvesting at night reduces, but does not remove, the chance of awakening one.

Shears suit mosses and hanging growth where their entries allow. Plant Dreamroot Bulbs instead of dropping them when you want a crop. Avoid stepping on Ember Moss, and keep Void Bramble away from ritual circles because it can disrupt nearby rituals.
manual.warlockery.infusions.title: Warlockery: Brews and Infusions
manual.warlockery.infusions.preamble: This book teaches how to place lasting magic in a person or an object. Choose a path, gather the pictured offerings, and mind your magic reserve. Later pages show every personal and object infusion.
manual.warlockery.infusions.paths:
The personal infusion rites grant five paths: Earth (shown as Overworld), Sky, Infernal, Light, and Otherwhere. Their rites and the Infusion Recharge rite are listed in Personal Infusions.

Earth controls stone and metal. Sky launches you and slows your descent. Light offers concealment and temporary barriers. Otherwhere offers teleportation. Infernal takes powers from sacrificed creatures; its starting personal power heals you.

A bound Flame Imp nearby grants temporary Imp attunement. Read Imp Attunement for the binding and distance requirements. Drinking an Infused Brew of the Grave grants Grave attunement for two hours.

Object infusions are separate. The Brew of Soaring improves an enchanted broom's handling; use the broom to fly. The object entries explain what each infused item actually does.
manual.warlockery.infusions.focus:
Aim the Arcane Focus before using it. Point into empty air for your personal power, at a living creature for a creature power, or at a block for a working at that position.

A Golden Chalk heart takes priority: using the Focus there opens Warlockery: Circle Magic if that book is in your inventory. Choose Perform Ritual on the entry you want to cast. Move your aim away from the heart to use an infusion power.

Arcane Focus: Controls explains path selection and reserve. Creatures and Blocks explains the targeted actions.
manual.warlockery.infusions.reserve:
The small bar shows your selected infusion's remaining reserve while you hold the Focus. Each path has its own reserve. Switching paths changes which reserve you spend. Automatic Effects explains additional costs from protection, attacks, and landings.

Personal / creature / block costs:
Imp: 4 / 8 / 10.
Infernal: 12 / 10 / 6.
Grave: 4 / 10 / 5.
Light: 8 / 12 / 14.
Otherwhere: 10 / 14 / 8.
Earth: 8 / 10 / 12.
Sky: 8 / 10 / 8.

The Infusion Recharge rite restores reserve to practitioners inside its circle by consuming altar power. An Attuned Stone can move power to the altar; carrying one does not replace your personal reserve.

If casting is refused, check the selected path, reserve, and target. Some powers need a nearby creature or safe space even when your reserve is full.
manual.warlockery.fumes.title: Warlockery: Collecting Fumes
manual.warlockery.fumes.preamble: This book teaches how to catch magical smoke. Feed the Alchemical Oven, give it fired clay jars, and leave room for every result. Each recipe page shows the input, the fume, and any ash or food left behind.
manual.warlockery.fumes.oven:
The Alchemical Oven draws virtue from wood, saplings, herbs, and other fitting organic matter. Ordinary logs and saplings yield Wood Ash or useful fumes; Alder, Hawthorn, and Rowan materials may release their own essences; prepared plants can yield Breath of the Goddess or Hint of Rebirth; raw pork may be altered by its proper recipe.

Feed raw material into one of the three input slots, put fired clay jars in the dedicated jar slot, add valid fuel, and leave room for the primary result and captured fume.
manual.warlockery.fumes.jars:
Shape a Soft Clay Jar from Minecraft clay, then fire it until it takes the warm color of terracotta. An empty fired jar cools a hot fume without surrendering it and bears a label suited to the captured substance.

Keep enough jars available before lighting the oven. Jarred reagents are ingredients, not generic storage, and machines reject a jar whose contents do not match the recipe.
manual.warlockery.fumes.funnels:
A Fume Funnel catches what the oven would otherwise lose. A Filtered Fume Funnel uses a Fume Filter to favor the intended essence and improve useful recovery.

The Sun Collector is a different instrument: under unobstructed daylight it charges a Quartz Sphere into a Sun Grenade. A Distillery separates prepared matter into Condensed Fear, Diamond Vapor, Ender Dew, Infernal Blood, Whiff of Magic, Refined Evil, or Oil of Vitriol.

Funnels, collectors, ovens, and stills accept hoppers, pipes, and pumps only where their vessels permit it.
manual.warlockery.symbology.title: Warlockery: Symbology
manual.warlockery.symbology.preamble: This book teaches magic held in signs, stones, branches, and foci. It explains what each tool can point at and what power it spends. Begin with the Arcane Focus, then read the page for the tool in your hand.
manual.warlockery.symbology.focus:
The Arcane Focus fixes intention upon a circle, creature, block, or the bearer. At a golden chalk heart it opens Warlockery: Circle Magic, which must be in your inventory. Choose a ritual entry, then Perform Ritual to check and cast it.

On compatible targets it directs infusions, bindings, necromancy, and other focused work. The Mystic Branch carries direct click-cast signs without requiring remembered mouse gestures.

Both spend the reserve of their selected path and fail harmlessly when no valid target or power remains.
manual.warlockery.symbology.gestures:
Waystones remember places; Blooded Waystones and creature-bound stones add sympathy. The Rite of Binding records a circle or location, Copy Waystone duplicates a destination, and Transposition carries a creature or caster to the matching bond.

A Sympathetic Vial records a creature identity for dolls, statues and rites. Bind a Player Compass by using it directly on another player. Bind a Doll Shelf Compass by crouching and using it on the particular shelf to remember. The Diviners and Compasses chapter gives their controls and limits.

Water and Lava Diviners search directly below a clicked block. The Seer Stone page explains readings, Happenstance Oil and calling your coven. Mirrors and Homeward Travel explains handheld Mirrors and Ruby Slippers.
manual.warlockery.symbology.deflection:
A Replication Staff records two opposite corners and copies a selection of up to 512 blocks, spending one durability when it places a copy. Read its named page under Enchanted Objects in Brews and Infusions. Replication Charges are separate thrown tools that create a Glass Doppelganger; their page is under Binding Tools in Conjuration and Fetishes.

A Ritual Knife can rest on an altar and is retrieved by crouching and using the altar. Attuned Stones carry altar power, while handheld Mirrors return you to a recorded reflection. Their named pages explain the target, charge and controls needed for each use.
manual.warlockery.torn_page.title: Torn Page
manual.warlockery.torn_page.immortal_fra:
The torn hand writes of a moon made red by invitation: call the Naamah beneath a full moon, defeat what answers, and offer her blood to another Matriarch. This fragment reveals no further secret by itself.

Carry it with Observations of an Immortal and use the page to restore the next missing passage of that volume.

manual.warlockery.codex.antidotes: A Universal Antidote is worked from a Null Catalyst, a Brew of Infection, and a Brew of Wasting. Drinking it draws out poison and wither without stripping helpful enchantments or blessings.

ritual.warlockery.forestation.descriptio: Raises a surrounding woodland from compatible saplings.
ritual.warlockery.fortification_of_the_c: Fortify nearby undead at night through this circle working. Keep the Necromantic Stone near the heart; the bones are consumed. A Brazier is not required for this rite.
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_infernal.desc: Transforms the outer glyphs into infernal chalk.
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_ritual.title: Rite of Glyphic Transformation: Ritual
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_ritual.descri: Prepare the Veil Chalk ring shown in the diagram, then offer Ritual Chalk to turn that ring into Ritual Chalk. A ring already drawn with Ritual Chalk cannot be transformed into the same color.
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_the_veil.titl: Rite of Glyphic Transformation: the Veil
ritual.warlockery.glyph_to_the_veil.desc: Transforms the outer glyphs into the_veil chalk.
ritual.warlockery.graveyard_mist.title: Graveyard Mist
ritual.warlockery.graveyard_mist.descrip: Fills the circle with ash that conceals and restores undead while blinding the living.
ritual.warlockery.hell_on_earth.title: Hex of Hell on Earth
ritual.warlockery.hell_on_earth.descript: Opens a sustained infernal breach at the circle or an extra bound Waystone while drawing power from the casting altar.
ritual.warlockery.hex_insanity.title: Hex of Insanity
ritual.warlockery.hex_insanity.descripti: Afflicts the imprint-bound being with visions and darkness.
ritual.warlockery.hex_misfortune.title: Hex of Misfortune
ritual.warlockery.hex_misfortune.descrip: Hexes the imprint-bound being with persistent bad luck.
ritual.warlockery.hex_nightmare.title: Hex of Waking Nightmare
ritual.warlockery.hex_nightmare.descript: Haunts the imprint-bound being with darkness and hunger.
ritual.warlockery.hex_overheating.title: Hex of Overheating
ritual.warlockery.hex_overheating.descri: Causes the imprint-bound being to burn with infernal fever.
ritual.warlockery.hex_sinking.title: Hex of Sinking
ritual.warlockery.hex_sinking.descriptio: Burdens the imprint-bound being with crushing supernatural weight.
ritual.warlockery.hex_wolf.title: Hex of the Wolf
ritual.warlockery.hex_wolf.description: Bestows lycanthropy on the imprint-bound mortal under a full moon with a full coven.
ritual.warlockery.ice_shell.title: Rite of Icy Expansion
ritual.warlockery.ice_shell.description: Builds a hollow packed-ice sphere, clears trapped fluids into breathable air, and grows with additional circle mages.
ritual.warlockery.imprisonment.title: Rite of Imprisonment
ritual.warlockery.imprisonment.descripti: Cripples movement inside the circle so captured foes cannot escape.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_grave.titl: Rite of Infusion: Brew of the Grave
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_grave.desc: Make a Grave Brew from the listed offerings. The completed brew appears above the heart after the cast.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_soaring.ti: Rite of Infusion: Brew of Soaring
ritual.warlockery.infuse_brew_soaring.de:
Make an Infused Brew of Soaring from the listed offerings. The completed brew appears above the heart after the cast.

Drink the brew to make an enchanted broom respond more quickly when steering for two hours. Ride the enchanted broom with its normal controls while the effect lasts. Drinking returns an empty glass bottle.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_broom.title: Rite of Infusion: Enchanted Broom
ritual.warlockery.infuse_broom.descripti:
Creates an enchanted broom from a mundane broom and flying ointment.

Use the enchanted broom normally to mount it; the broom is stored while you ride. Use W, A, S, and D to steer, look up or down to pitch, press Space to climb, and hold Glide Down (Left Alt by default) for a gentle descent. Press Shift while riding to dismount and return the broom to your inventory.

While standing, hold Shift and use the enchanted broom on a glyph to clear a 5 by 5 area. An ordinary broom clears only the glyph you use it on.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_crystal_ball.de: Infuses a quartz sphere for divination.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mirror.title: Rite of Infusion: Mirror
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mirror.descript: Condenses a crafted mirror surface into a portable infernal reflection.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_mystic_branch.d: Infuses a branch with focused natural magic.
ritual.warlockery.infuse_seer_stone.desc: Infuses a stone for communication among a coven.
ritual.warlockery.infusion_earth.title: Rite of Infusion: Earth
ritual.warlockery.infusion_earth.descrip: Infuses those in the circle with the endurance of stone.
ritual.warlockery.infusion_ender.title: Rite of Infusion: the Veil
ritual.warlockery.infusion_ender.descrip: Infuses those in the circle with otherworldly speed.
ritual.warlockery.infusion_hell.title: Rite of Infusion: Infernal
ritual.warlockery.infusion_hell.descript: Grants Infernal attunement for enthralling creatures and taking their powers through sacrifice.
ritual.warlockery.infusion_light.title: Rite of Infusion: Light
ritual.warlockery.infusion_light.descrip: Infuses those in the circle with radiant sight.
ritual.warlockery.infusion_sky.title: Rite of Infusion: Sky
ritual.warlockery.infusion_sky.descripti: Infuses those in the circle with the grace of flight.
ritual.warlockery.manifestation.title: Rite of Manifestation
ritual.warlockery.manifestation.descript: Grants a sleeping spirit walker permission to manifest through a Spirit Portal for two and a half minutes, extended by twenty-five seconds per additional nearby participant, including players and owned Circle Mages.
ritual.warlockery.natures_power.title: Rite of Nature's Power
ritual.warlockery.natures_power.descript: Repairs compatible soil and damaged vegetation, then forces natural growth across the area.
ritual.warlockery.necrostone.title: Rite of Necromancy: Necromantic Stone
ritual.warlockery.necrostone.description: Creates a Necromantic Stone under the night sky.
ritual.warlockery.part_earth.title: Rite of Broken Earth
ritual.warlockery.part_earth.description: Tears a deep fissure through compatible natural ground in the caster's facing direction.
ritual.warlockery.prior_incarnation.desc: Recovers the bound player's surviving dropped belongings from their most recent recorded death and brings them to the circle.
ritual.warlockery.rain_of_toads.title: Hex of Raining Toads
ritual.warlockery.rain_of_toads.descript: Calls rain before poisonous and safely exploding toads fall into the ritual area.
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth.title: Rite of Moving Earth
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth.descriptio: Raises a medium stone column around the heart. Keep creatures clear and stand at least four blocks horizontally from the heart while it forms to avoid being trapped inside.
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth_small.desc: Raises a compact stone column around the heart. Keep creatures clear and stand at least four blocks horizontally from the heart while it forms to avoid being trapped inside.
ritual.warlockery.raise_earth_large.desc: Raises a broad, tall stone column around the heart. Keep creatures clear and stand at least four blocks horizontally from the heart while it forms to avoid being trapped inside.
ritual.warlockery.recharge_infusion.desc: Restores magical reserve and regeneration to infused witches while a nearby altar can supply 40 power each second.
ritual.warlockery.sanctity.title: Rite of Sanctity
ritual.warlockery.sanctity.description: Protects beings inside the circle from hostile attack.
ritual.warlockery.spectral_stone.title: Rite of Necromancy: Spectral Stone
ritual.warlockery.spectral_stone.descrip: Infuses a Spectral Stone under the night sky.
ritual.warlockery.storm.title: Rite of Sky's Wrath
ritual.warlockery.storm.description: Calls a violent thunderstorm and strikes the bound or nearest target with lightning.
ritual.warlockery.storm_large.title: Greater Rite of Sky's Wrath
ritual.warlockery.storm_large.descriptio: Calls an extended thunderstorm over the world.
ritual.warlockery.storm_portable.title: Portable Rite of Sky's Wrath
ritual.warlockery.storm_portable.descrip: Calls a focused thunderstorm from a circle talisman.
ritual.warlockery.summon_banshee.title: Rite of Summoning: Banshee
ritual.warlockery.summon_banshee.descrip: Calls a banshee from beyond the veil.
ritual.warlockery.summon_cat_familiar.de: Calls a cat familiar that can be bound as a persistent magical companion.
ritual.warlockery.summon_circle_mage.des: Calls a Circle Mage who can be recruited with a familiar and a coven offering.
ritual.warlockery.blood_audience.title: Blood Audience
ritual.warlockery.blood_audience.descrip: Bring an unmarried Nami to an Ocean Monument and defeat its Elder Guardians first. Perform the rite beneath the full moon to awaken Naamah.
ritual.warlockery.summon_demon.title: Rite of Summoning: Demon
ritual.warlockery.summon_demon.descripti: Calls a Warlockery demon from the infernal realm.
ritual.warlockery.summon_familiar.title: Rite of Summoning: Spectral Familiar
ritual.warlockery.summon_familiar.descri: Summons a Spectral Familiar. For a cat, use Rite of Calling: Cat Familiar instead. Summoning does not bind the creature to you; follow Rite of Binding: Familiar afterward.
ritual.warlockery.summon_forgewarden.des: Calls a combat-ready Forgewarden who empowers nearby goblins.
ritual.warlockery.summon_imp.title: Rite of Summoning: Imp
ritual.warlockery.summon_imp.description: Calls a flame imp that can be bound through infernal contracts.
ritual.warlockery.summon_lost_soul.title: Rite of Calling: Lost Soul
ritual.warlockery.summon_lost_soul.descr: Draws a Lost Soul into the world so it can be bound with a spirit vessel.
ritual.warlockery.summon_parasytic_louse: Calls a Parasytic Louse that can capture and redirect potion effects.
ritual.warlockery.summon_poltergeist.des: Calls a Poltergeist needed by the greater Rite of Binding.
ritual.warlockery.summon_reflection.desc: Releases the hostile echo_shade held within an infused mirror.
ritual.warlockery.summon_spectre.title: Rite of Summoning: Spectre
ritual.warlockery.summon_spectre.descrip: Draws a spectre through the veil into the ritual circle.
ritual.warlockery.summon_stonebroker.des: Calls the armored Stonebroker patron for combat, worship, and goblin blessings.
ritual.warlockery.summon_storm_simian.de: Shapes a storm-touched flying familiar that can travel to bound waystones.
ritual.warlockery.summon_thorned_pursuer: Consumes four bloodied wicker bundles at the cardinal points to call the Thorned Pursuer.
ritual.warlockery.summon_witch.title: Rite of Summoning: Witch
ritual.warlockery.summon_witch.descripti: Calls a witch to the center of the prepared circle.
ritual.warlockery.summon_wither.title: Rite of Summoning: Wither
ritual.warlockery.summon_wither.descript: Calls forth a Wither; clear the inner circle before beginning.
ritual.warlockery.teleport_entity.title: Rite of Transposition: Creature
ritual.warlockery.teleport_entity.descri: Summons the creature or player identified by a bound sympathetic imprint.
ritual.warlockery.teleport_waystone.desc: Teleports the caster to a position-bound Waystone. Travel to another dimension requires an active Otherwhere infusion.
ritual.warlockery.transpose_ore.title: Rite of Transposition: Ore
ritual.warlockery.transpose_ore.descript: Draws ore from the rock below and deposits it at the circle.
ritual.warlockery.volcano.title: Rite of Earth's Wrath
ritual.warlockery.volcano.description: Draws a nearby underground volcanic fluid pool into a contained basalt vent.

manual.warlockery.biome.entry.green_land: %s holds trees, grass, flowers, or fertile soil. Seek it for wood, herbs, animals, and gentle nature magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.waters_and: %s holds rivers, ocean water, marshes, or shores. Seek it for fish, clay, water plants, and water magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.cold_lands: %s holds snow, ice, high stone, or cold trees. Seek it for frost ingredients, mountain stone, goats, and cold magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.dry_and_wi: %s holds sand, red stone, acacia, or strong wind. Seek it for dry plants, terracotta, gold, and weather magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.caves_and_: %s holds deep stone, cave plants, mushrooms, sculk, or eerie emptiness. Seek it for rare ores, spores, echoes, and hidden magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.nether_bio: %s is a hot and dangerous Nether land with fire, strange fungi, or soul-touched ground. Seek it for infernal ingredients and fire magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.end_biomes: %s is a lonely End land with end stone, chorus growth, and the power of distance. Seek it for ender ingredients and travel magic.
manual.warlockery.machine_recipe.entry: This page teaches the %s working. Add the shown vessels and ingredients in order, supply any listed fluid or fuel, and leave room for every result.

manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sca:
Use the Scarecrow binding rite for its exact chalk diagram, ingredients, power, and spirit combinations. A single spectral creature is not enough: bring one complete group listed by the rite.

After casting, collect the bound Scarecrow above the heart. Place it and use an empty hand to read its state.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_tre: The Trent Effigy is a wooden promise offered to the forest. Place it on firm ground and present a sapling, flower, or seed. A valid offering is consumed and an Ent wakes above the effigy, shaped by the land in which it is called.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dre: Hang this pale weave within eight blocks of the bed. After a full sleep it leaves regeneration upon the waking body. A nearby nightmare weave can sour that blessing into poison unless protective dream plants stand watch.

The green weave gathers the memory of a feast. Sleep beside it and wake with hunger and saturation restored. A Weaver of Intensity strengthens the meal, while an unwarded nightmare twists fullness into ravenous hunger.

The blue weave teaches sleeping feet to remember the wind. A proper night's rest grants Speed; an Intensity weave sharpens it, while an unwarded nightmare leaves the limbs heavy with Slowness and Weakness.

The magenta weave is an amplifier, best hung beside another helpful pattern. It strengthens Fasting, Fleet Foot, and Iron Arm dreams and grants Night Vision when it is the nearest weave to the bed. Nightmare corruption still overrules its aid.

The silver-gray weave fills the waking arms with industrious force, granting Haste after a full sleep. Intensity hones that strength. An unwarded nightmare answers instead with Mining Fatigue and Weakness.

The black weave turns sleep against every nearby blessing. One brings Weakness; two deepen the visitation with Blindness. Protective dream plants catch the malice and return Absorption instead, so ward the bed before hanging it.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_all:
The Alluring Skull calls susceptible creatures from sixteen blocks away. Place it where the path is safe, use a compatible activating focus to awaken or quiet it, and inspect it with an empty hand.

While active it sheds soul motes and continually draws valid creatures toward its jaw.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sta: The Goddess Statue is a cleansing fetish. Use it while burdened by an active hex and it strips the hostile bindings from you. If no hex answers, the statue reports that there is nothing to cleanse and remains ready for a later supplicant.

Bind the Statue of Worship to a living target before placing it. A valid patron offering of gold or goblinite calls Luck II and Haste I upon that bound target for two minutes. Using an empty hand reveals whose sympathy the statue carries.

The Statue of Broken Hexes is a direct cleansing fetish. Touch it while carrying one or more hexes and every active hex is severed. It consumes no offering, but it has no effect when no baneful bond is present.

The Statue of Occluded Summons guards a place against circle work. Use it with an empty hand to awaken or quiet its ward. An active statue inhibits nearby rituals, so keep it away from your own chalk unless you intend to bar every working in its reach.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dol:
A Doll Shelf accepts only dolls and sympathetic vessels. It keeps its own chunk awake, allowing stored bound dolls to answer their owner from afar. Use the shelf screen to read its bindings and remove a doll before its remaining durability is spent.

Dolls keep the side of the dream where they were made. Physical-world dolls and shelves cannot reach your spirit. Craft and bind new dolls inside the Spirit World to use them there; those dolls stop working outside, even if rebound or moved. Dolls cannot target the sleeping body in place of its dreamer.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.sympatheti: A Sympathetic Vial may take an imprint directly from a living creature, from a Blood Rose or Leech Chest, or from the claimed bed of a sleeping player. Its name and glow reveal a successful binding.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.beast_spee: Hold a Beast-Speech Charm, offer an animal a food it likes, and use the charm on that animal. The charm lets you understand one another, so a sheep or other friendly beast may trade a gift for your offering. The Silver Tongue Charm speaks to demons instead.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_artich: Water Artichoke favors cultivated wet ground. Harvest the mature crop for Artichoke, a cooling garden reagent used in brews and preparations that draw upon water and living growth.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_bellad: Belladonna is the poisoner of the garden. Its mature leaves enter harmful brews, mutating compounds, and rites that need a living herb with a baneful nature. Keep it planted until fully grown for the best yield.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_garlic: Garlic is both crop and ward. Harvest it for cookery and brewing, braid it into a Garlic Garland, or carry it into vampire work. Vampires burn when they press against a proper garlic ward.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_mandra:
Plant Mandrake seeds on farmland and wait until the crop is fully grown. Uprooting a mature plant can awaken a hostile Mandrake: the chance is 75% by day and 25% at night. Harvest at night to reduce the risk, and keep a weapon ready. Defeat an awakened Mandrake to collect its root.

Mandrake roots are used in brews and rites. Four mature Mandrake plants also form the cardinal roots of the Dreamroot mutation.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_dreamr:
Dreamroot is born through the prepared Mandrake mutation described under Mutations. Its harvest feeds dream magic and yields Dreamroot Bulbs. Use a bulb on farmland to continue the crop.

A bulb dropped loose can wake into a living Dreamroot after at least three seconds. The creature is not automatically tamed or bound to you. Plant bulbs directly when you want a crop. The Dreamroot Bulb page explains planting, waking and stack limits.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_snowbe:
Plant Snowbell seeds on farmland and wait for the mature crop. Harvesting gives snowballs and has a 20% chance to drop an Icy Needle without Fortune. Fortune improves the needle chance. If you need a needle, grow and harvest several plants; save dropped seeds for replanting.

Icy Needles are used in cold-aligned recipes and can wake you from the Spirit World.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wolfsb: Wolfsbane is cultivated wherever lycanthropes are hunted or cured. Its harvest belongs in werewolf rites, hunter preparations, and brews intended to trouble the beast within.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wormwo: Wormwood is a bitter bridge to spirits. Save both herb and seed for spectral brews, fumigation, and rites concerned with the dead or the veil. A mature bed provides the dependable supply these workings consume.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_ember_: Ember Moss spreads slowly across compatible ground and shines with banked heat. Living creatures that cross it without protection may ignite. Use it as a warning carpet, a fiery reagent, or a source of warm occult light.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_glint_: Glint Weed is a bright, self-spreading herb that thrives on compatible ground. It gives strong natural light without flame and serves wherever a working calls for luminous living growth.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_spanis: Spanish Moss hangs rather than stands. Let it trail from a suitable support and harvest it with care for weaving, hanging charms, and recipes that need a soft plant fiber touched by damp air.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_somnia: Somnian Cotton gathers the residue of sleep. At night or during a waking nightmare it yields Disturbed Cotton, the fiber used for dream-bound threads and protective weaves. In ordinary daylight it remains dormant.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_leapin: Leaping Lilies favor water gardens. A creature brushing their leaves receives a brief blessing of speed and strengthened jumping. Plant them along safe crossings or harvest them for motion-aligned brewing.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_blood_: The Blood Rose answers violence and blood-bound craft. Grow it apart from peaceful beds and reserve its petals for vampire work, blood reagents, and rites where a living flower must remember harm.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_brambl: Bramble is a thorned living barrier. It slows a careless path, supplies thorn-aligned ingredients, and suits defensive gardens where an ordinary fence would carry no magical sympathy.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_void_b: Void Bramble catches flesh and stills nearby ritual power. Plant it to deny hostile circles or protect a threshold, but keep it well beyond your own chalk before beginning a rite.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_grassp: A Grassper holds one offered item visibly above its leaves and returns it when used again. Four diagonal Grasspers serve as ingredient pedestals in advanced living mutations, including the rites that create Toads and Dreamroot.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_pitgra: Pitgrass disguises prepared pit ground with a grassy face. Use it in concealed garden traps and defensive paths where ordinary grass would reveal the hollow beneath.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_critte: Craft a Critter Snare from four wooden sticks, one string, and three planks, then place it where a bat, silverfish, or tiny slime can step into it. The snare captures one compatible creature and preserves it when the block is moved. Use the placed filled snare with an empty hand to release its creature. Filled Slime snares are living ingredients in the Toad mutation.

manual.warlockery.conjuration.spirit_wor:
Eat a Sleeping Apple to force a nightmare, or fall asleep under a Sleeping Brew, which begins with a ninety-five percent nightmare risk. Every survival entry leaves your sleeping body at your entry position in that dimension, wearing your skin. This also applies when you enter from the Nether or End. Your body stays there while you manifest. Creative entry leaves no body.

Only a Nightmare Dream Weaver within eight blocks changes the odds: one Weaver subtracts fifty points, each Flowing Spirit subtracts ten up to three, and each Wispy Cotton subtracts ten up to two. Each Demon Heart adds thirty-five up to two, and each fire adds ten up to three.

The final risk remains between zero and ninety-five percent.

Wispy Cotton, Disturbed Cotton, Icy Needles, and both Verdant Catalysts can enter the dream. Your other original belongings are stored and restored when you wake. Only those permitted items and the Spirit creature drops listed in Gathering What Dreams Grow can leave. Ordinary mined resources and building materials cannot come home.

Use an Icy Needle or an ordinary Spirit Portal to wake. Destruction of your sleeping body or a mortal dream wound wakes you before death. With Manifestation permission, a portal instead takes you to the waking world temporarily; use one needle to return to the dream, then another to wake.

Dolls made outside cannot affect your spirit. Craft and bind dolls inside the Spirit World to use them there; they work only inside. Your sleeping body cannot be targeted by a doll in place of your spirit.

Circle Magic cannot be cast in the Spirit World.

The Spirit World shares the natural Overworld landscape, without copying player buildings or mining. Wispy Cotton and free spirits gather sparingly near dreamers. Nightmares stain cotton into Disturbed Cotton.

You can bring home Wispy Cotton, Disturbed Cotton, Icy Needles, both Verdant Catalysts, Subdued Spirit, Mellifluous Hunger, Gunpowder, Magma Cream, and Demon Hearts. These are the permitted dream materials and creature drops. Ordinary ores, stone, wood, and other building materials cannot leave.

Verdant Catalysts reveal dream transformations. Flowing Spirit can be made in a cauldron only here. Spirit Buckets, Flowing Spirit, and other dream supplies stay in the dream.

An ordinary nightmare darkens the sky and sends a Nightmare to hunt the dreamer. For the rarer demonic nightmare, sleep under a Sleeping Brew within eight blocks of a Dream Weaver set to Nightmares, Flowing Spirit, and a placed Demon Heart.

That complete arrangement has an eight percent chance to call demons and harmless fiery rain. A Sleeping Apple forces an ordinary nightmare but never the demonic kind.

manual.warlockery.circles.golden_chalk:
Yellow chalk is called Golden Chalk in the inventory and JEI. Combine 1 Gypsum with 1 Yellow Dye in any crafting arrangement to make 1 Golden Chalk with 64 uses.

Getting Gypsum
1. Craft Soft Clay Jars from clay balls, then fire them in a furnace to make Clay Jars.
2. Feed a log and a Clay Jar into a fueled Alchemical Oven. Collect the Wood Ash and Foul Fume.
3. Craft Wood Ash into Quicklime.
4. Put Foul Fume, Quicklime, and a Clay Jar into a Distillery within range of an active altar. This working takes 40 seconds and draws 480 total altar power gradually. Collect the Gypsum alongside Oil of Vitriol and a Slimeball.

The Chalk chapter contains every chalk recipe, the jars and machines, and the Wood Ash, Foul Fume, and Gypsum workings. The Distilling book also lists the Gypsum working under Distilling Oil of Vitriol. In JEI, look up recipes for Gypsum or uses for Foul Fume.

Use Golden Chalk on the ground to place the ritual heart. Crouch while placing it to draw a golden ring mark instead.

Search for Ritual Knife in the inventory or JEI. Craft it from 1 Flint above and to the right of 1 Stick; its exact pattern is in Crafting Guides.

Altar range upgrade
Use the Ritual Knife on a formed altar to install it and double the altar power distribution range. This is optional: the altar works at its normal range without a knife. Crouch and use the altar with an empty hand to remove the most recent attachment.

Harvesting
Kills made with the Ritual Knife can yield special creature ingredients. JEI lists their sources on the knife and the harvested ingredients. Looting improves the chances.

The Arcane Focus is a separate tool. Use that on the golden ritual heart to open the ritual selection screen.
jei.warlockery.info.arthana_harvest: Use a Ritual Knife for the killing blow. These are chance drops. Looting improves the chance. Modpacks can extend the eligible creature groups.

manual.warlockery.onboarding.first_steps:
First workshop
If you need your first Belladonna, start with the Herbology book and its Warlock farming instructions. Its recipe uses only ordinary flowers, black dye, a book, and a feather.

1. Craft the Alchemical Oven and Clay Jars using the Fume Workshop recipes. Add fuel to the oven.
2. Process a Birch Sapling with a Clay Jar to collect Breath of the Goddess.
3. Use a breath to craft the Distilling book. Make a Distillery, then follow that book to build an altar and distill your first ingredients.
4. Make Whiff of Magic in the Distillery, then craft Circle Magic for chalk and rituals.

Keep your books in your inventory. Blue references open the named section; Back returns to the page you were reading.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.distillery:
Make a Distillery first: place Glass Bottles above, below, left, and right of an Iron Ingot in a crafting table. The next pages show the Distillery and Altar recipes.

Build the altar before loading a powered recipe. Open the Distillery, put each listed ingredient and Clay Jar in an input slot, and leave room for every output. The Distillery uses altar power, not furnace fuel. A recipe starts automatically when its inputs, power, and output space are ready. The progress arrow shows it working.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.altar:
Build the altar
Craft the Altar recipe twice for 6 blocks. Place all six in one flat 2 by 3 rectangle, at the same height, with no extra altar blocks touching it. Right-click with an empty hand to check formation and stored power. Allow a few seconds for the altar to update.

Place a Distillery or another powered machine within 32 blocks horizontally. For a ritual, keep an altar block within 32 blocks horizontally of its golden heart. In both cases the altar must be no more than 4 blocks below or 6 above. Keeping everything on the same level is easiest.

Living plants and trees around the altar increase its capacity and recharge. Power fills over time; capacity is not the same as stored power. Wait until the stored amount meets the recipe or ritual requirement. Machine recipes marked continuous draw the displayed total gradually. An active ritual reserves power, so other workings cannot spend it.

Attach a Ritual Knife to the altar to double its reach: 64 blocks horizontally, with the altar up to 8 blocks below or 12 above the working. The ordinary 32-block range works without a knife.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.cast:
Cast a first ritual
1. Open Rite of Broiling in Warlockery: Circle Magic and copy its chalk diagram onto flat ground. Each grid square is one ground block. Use Ritual Chalk for the white marks and Golden Chalk for the center heart.
2. Drop one Coal or Charcoal and some raw food, such as Raw Beef, near the heart. Keep offerings within 6 blocks of the heart.
3. Charge a nearby completed altar to at least 600 power. Keep the Circle Magic book in your inventory and use it on the golden heart. It reopens your saved entry.
4. Open Rite of Broiling and choose Perform Ritual. Read every checklist page, fix missing items, marks, or power, and use Refresh. When ready, choose Begin.
5. Leave the pattern intact and wait 5 seconds. The bar shows casting progress; the coal is consumed and raw food becomes cooked food. Pick up the result.

Back to ritual entry returns to the instructions. Closing the casting page saves the ordinary reading page, so you can always return to the guide. The selected rite remains displayed above the golden heart. A Ritual Knife is an optional altar attachment.
manual.warlockery.onboarding.seeds:
Your first seeds
Make a Distillery from 4 Glass Bottles around an Iron Ingot. Put it near an unemployed adult villager so they can become a Warlock. Prepare empty, watered farmland nearby and leave the villager room to reach it. Warlocks plant one randomly chosen starter herb; different Warlocks may plant different herbs. Harvest a mature crop for herbs and seeds, then replant. Villager farming requires mob griefing to be enabled.

For an Arcane Focus, grow Belladonna and Mandrake. You need 2 Belladonna, 1 Mandrake Root, and 2 Sticks. Keep looking for a Warlock planting the herb you need; a Warlock buying seeds is not selling them.

Herbology is your first book: craft it with a flower above and below a Book, Black Dye to its left, and a Feather to its right. After your first Belladonna harvest, craft the Oven book to begin collecting fumes.
manual.warlockery.ritual.cast_time: Keep Warlockery: Circle Magic in your inventory. Use it on the golden heart to reopen your saved entry and select that rite for the floating display. Open this rite and choose Perform Ritual, then Begin when its checklist is ready. Casting takes %1$s seconds. Keep the chalk and offerings in place until it finishes. Back to ritual entry returns to this page; closing the casting page also saves this reading position.

Bring a complete group of living spirits within 6 blocks of the heart before casting. The group determines the bound mode:
Voodoo Protection: 3 Spirits, 1 Spectre, 1 Banshee, 1 Poltergeist.
Sentinel: 3 Spirits and 3 Spectres.
Shrieking: 3 Spirits and 2 Banshees.
Disorientation: 3 Spirits and 2 Poltergeists.
Ghost Walking: 3 Spirits, 1 Spectre, 1 Banshee.

Use one group at a time. If several groups are present, the first matching group above takes priority. The required spirits are consumed and the bound item appears above the heart. Pick it up and check its bound mode.

Additional structure: place 4 Wicker Bundles at the same height as the chalk heart, exactly 2 blocks north, south, east, and west of it. Use a blood source, such as Raw Beef, on each bundle until it becomes bloodied. Each use consumes one blood source. The cast consumes all four prepared bundles. Keep them separate from the dropped ingredient offerings.

Stand in a diagonal gap between the bundles when aiming the Circle Magic book at the golden heart; aiming through a bundle hits the bundle instead.
manual.warlockery.ritual.cook_setup: Also drop raw food, such as Raw Beef, near the heart. Coal is consumed as the offering; dropped food within 6 blocks is changed into its cooked result. Pick up the cooked food after casting.

Provide any altar power listed by that recipe. Close the screen and use Flint and Steel or a Fire Charge on the Brazier to ignite it. Leave the Wood Ash inside while it burns. The working can summon a spirit or affect nearby creatures as described on its recipe page.

Use a Water Bucket or Water Bottle to extinguish it and clear its contents. Check your recipe before lighting: unrelated ingredients can prevent a match.
manual.warlockery.distilling.spinningwhe:
Craft a Spinning Wheel using its recipe, and place it near a powered altar. Put the recipe's first ingredient in its primary slot and the remaining ingredients in the other input slots. Use exactly one recipe's ingredients at a time.

It needs no fire or furnace fuel. Leave its output slot clear. Recipes start automatically and draw the listed total altar power gradually. Collect the thread, twine, or web when progress finishes.
manual.warlockery.distilling.silvervat:
Craft the Silver Vat using its recipe. Place it directly above a lit Campfire or Magma Block for ingredient processing. Put an Iron Ingot and Oil of Vitriol into its input slots; after 20 seconds, collect 3 Silver Dust from its outputs. This working needs no altar power.

The vat can also collect silver deposits from completed smelting cycles in a furnace directly beside it. This is a separate passive source: keep output space free and allow the neighboring furnace to finish actual smelting cycles.

manual.warlockery.ritual.setup.site: Before casting, drop item offerings within 6 blocks of the golden heart. The checklist uses dropped items, not items still in your inventory. Keep the heart, required chalk and any required altar intact throughout the cast, and remain in the same dimension. Circle Magic cannot be cast in the Spirit World.
